verdict.rationale: Honeycomb offers Triggers/SLOs that autonomously fire alerts and route them to webhooks or third-party services based on defined thresholds, which is a form of background automation, and an API for programmatically managing these. However, there is no evidence of AI-native autonomous automations (e.g., agent-driven scheduled investigations, self-running remediation workflows, or scheduled AI tasks) — the MCP server and agent-skills integrations are reactive/query-driven, invoked by a human or agent session rather than running independently in the background. missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/autonomous AI-driven workflows, agentic background jobs, or automated investigation triggers beyond simple threshold alerts, and any independent corroboration of such capability.
